shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/*/; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -name "cookies*" -o -name "headers*"
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions; sed -n 1,120p cookies.md; echo ======; sed -n 1,120p headers.md; cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40

cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20 && (npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Current theme.*language.*' | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g'; curl -s -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CH;q=0.5, de;q=0.9, en;q=0.8' localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Current theme.*language.*' | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g'; pkill -f "next start"
